recipes.title: Spinach and cheddar omelette
recipes.summary: A fluffy omelette that uses up the eggs, spinach and the end of the cheddar.

steps.instruction: Whisk the eggs with the milk and a pinch of salt. Grate the cheddar.
Melt the butter in a frying pan, wilt the spinach, then pour in the eggs and cook until almost set.
Scatter over the cheddar, fold in half and slide onto plates.

pairing.reason: Sharp, salty cheddar wakes up the mild, slightly bitter spinach.

recipes.title: Garlicky spinach and egg rice bowl
recipes.summary: Crispy rice, wilted spinach and soft-boiled eggs, ready in under 20 minutes.

steps.instruction: Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, then cool them in cold water.
Fry the onion and garlic, then add the rice and fry until it starts to crisp.
Stir in the spinach and soy sauce, spoon into bowls and top with the halved eggs.

pairing.reason: Garlic and soy give the rice a savoury punch, and the runny yolk turns into a sauce.

recipes.title: Chorizo and apple fried rice with pesto yogurt
recipes.summary: A quick fried rice that uses up the leftover rice and spinach, with a cool pesto yogurt on top.

steps.instruction: Slice the chorizo and red onion, and cut the apple into small cubes.
Fry the chorizo in a dry pan until it releases its red oil, then add the onion.
Add the apple and rice. Fry on high, stirring, until the rice starts to crisp. Splash in the soy sauce.
Push the rice aside, scramble the eggs in the gap, then stir everything together with the spinach until it wilts.
Stir the pesto into the yogurt and spoon it over the top to serve.

pairing.reason: The apple's sharp sweetness cuts through the smoky, fatty chorizo the way a high note cuts through a bass line. The cool pesto yogurt then brings the dish back down, like a rest at the end of a bar.
